newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA JSE APPOINTS KAGISO'S MOLEBI TO COMMITTEE.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA JSE APPOINTS KAGISO'S MOLEBI TO COMMITTEE.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Thursday that Eric Molobi, initiator of black investment firm Kagiso Trust Investments, has been appointed to the JSE Committee with effect from Januray 1, 1997.
Molobi, a former political prisoner, will be a non-stockbroker member of the committee.
Molobi is currently special advisor to Kagiso Trust, serves on numerous statutory bodies and is chairman of Kagiso Financial Services, a joint venture created last month with the NM Rothschild Group.
